wedgeWhitelistCheck: No contracts (W5-C probes the effect-laundering boundary, not the prover). Effect boundaries are bcl-io manifest-covered: File.WriteAllText -> fs:w; File.Exists / File.ReadAllText -> fs:r. The laundering edge is a bare-name first-order intra-module call chain of length three (LookupSession -> MarkActive -> WriteIndex -> File.WriteAllText) - EffectEnforcementPass's covered path per Annex A-1.2's scope guards; no delegates, no lambdas, no dispatch. Both the intermediate helper's and the writer's own fs:w declarations are honest; the violated declaration is the top-level caller's.
